title: Noetherian henselization of a Noetherian pair has the same completion
statement: Let $(A,I)$ be a pair with $A$ Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $(A^h,I^h)$ be its henselization [lem-weil-pbc-pair-henselization]. Thus $I^h=IA^h$. For the adic completions $A^\wedge=\varprojlim_n A/I^n$ and $(A^h)^\wedge=\varprojlim_n A^h/(I^h)^n$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], the canonical map $A\to A^h$ induces an isomorphism $A^\wedge\xrightarrow{\sim}(A^h)^\wedge$. Moreover $A^h$ is Noetherian, $A\to A^h$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], and $A^h\to A^\wedge$ is faithfully flat.
